name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
v2.1.43 — The Ring UI journey is complete. Every dialog, the settings window and all toast notifications now render as genuine Ring UI React components — one consistent, accessible, polished interface from end to end.

What's new since v2.1.13:
• Full UI on real Ring UI (#32) — all 20 modal surfaces, the redesigned two-pane settings window, and toast notifications were migrated off the legacy DOM bridge onto native Ring React. Unified styling, focus handling, ARIA and keyboard behaviour throughout.
• Task state on the Gantt (#20) — every task shows its current YouTrack state as a coloured badge, the previous state and how long ago it changed; bar colour now reflects state.
• Reliability — single-click checkboxes and row actions in the task picker and grids (B10/B11/B12), working-copy persistence across reload and tabs (B14/B15), and a role-items schema fix (#37).

15 UI languages. No breaking changes — sprints, history and settings upgrade in place.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
